issue: Combo crashes reused the board-edge event origin, which clamped to the same mountain shoulder. Missing origins selected only two fixed coordinates.
change: Sample both visible shoulder intervals with the theme's seeded RNG. Exclude neighborhoods of the last two terrain-local landing coordinates, then sample the exact baked crest. Failed pool acquisitions do not advance landing history. Legacy peaks are randomized with a preference for visible peaks.

visual.instrument: Chrome DevTools MCP, isolated native WebGPU fixture using the actual theme crash methods.
visual.result: Each sequence used the identical gameplay origin for 12 pooled spawns and produced 6 left-side and 6 right-side landings at varied ridge positions. Captured both sides; no browser/WebGPU errors.

rendering: Selection runs only when a crash successfully spawns. Particle budgets, materials, draw passes and frame-loop updates are unchanged. No new full-game FPS measurement was performed.
